name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static site content, self-signed certificates, Fail2ban, UFW firewall rules, sysctl hardening, and SSH hardening.

name: cache
description: Configures Memcached and Redis on port 6379, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and post-configuration cleanup of replication directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application by installing prerequisites, cloning the application, creating a Python virtual environment, installing dependencies, provisioning PostgreSQL, and running the app as a systemd service on port 8000.
